summary: PulseGuard v0.6.23 adds a visible WinGet application-update stage to FIX + OPTIMIZE ALL so installed applications can be upgraded as part of the normal maintenance workflow.

sections.heading: Visible WinGet application updates
sections.detail: FIX + OPTIMIZE ALL now opens a normal visible Command Prompt titled PulseGuard PC - Updating Applications and runs winget upgrade --all so the user can watch WinGet process available application upgrades.

sections.heading: PulseGuard waits before continuing
sections.detail: The optimizer keeps its own window responsive while the Command Prompt is open and waits for WinGet to finish before application-integrity verification and later repair stages continue.

sections.heading: Safe failure handling
sections.detail: If WinGet is unavailable or the command returns a non-zero exit code, the application-update stage is recorded as a warning instead of aborting the complete FIX + OPTIMIZE ALL workflow.

sections.heading: Version alignment
sections.detail: The PulseGuard runtime version and release-notes version are aligned to v0.6.23 for this build.
